name: Orange Cookies
summary: **Orange Cookies** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Obsoul33t Genetics]]. A cross of [[gsc|GSC]] and Orange Juice, itself a cross of [[california-orange|California Orange]] and [[og-kush|OG Kush]], it is grown as a mostly indica hybrid and can be cultivated indoors or outdoors.
